title: Satellites
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: An amateur satellite is a relay in orbit. You send a signal up, and it sends it back down.
lines.label: a relay in orbit

lines.caption: The path up is the uplink. The path down is the downlink. They use two different bands.
lines.label: uplink and downlink

lines.caption: Most amateur satellites fly in low Earth orbit. They circle the Earth in around one hundred minutes.
lines.label: low Earth orbit

lines.caption: A tracking program tells you when a satellite will pass, and where to point.
lines.label: tracking

lines.caption: Because it moves so fast, the frequency you hear slides from high to low. That is Doppler shift.
lines.label: Doppler shift

lines.caption: The satellite's power is shared by everyone. Use only as much as you need.
lines.label: share the power
